exposure: type of necrotizing enterocolitis (totalis NEC vs surgical non-totalis NEC)
cohort: Infants who underwent surgery for necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) were identified through The Children's Hospitals Neonatal Database.
finding: Infants with necrotizing enterocolitis totalis (tNEC) experience significantly higher mortality (96.9%) compared to those with surgical non-totalis NEC (sNEC) (26.5%).
